changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6661-app-launcher-nav-menu-renderers.md`

- names `en.ts` → `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` — edited by this change

  > Three new strings — the launcher's and the menu's accessible names, and the menu's empty state — are declared under `console.nav` in `en.ts` and its nine sibling packs. An inline `defaultValue` alone is not a fix: it renders English at one call site and leaves the string untranslatable everywhere (objectui#3517).

### `.changeset/7997-detail-view-related-retired.md`

- names `RecordDetailView.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **Why it retired.** `@objectstack/spec` declares no `DetailView` schema at all — every `DetailView` occurrence in `packages/spec/src` is prose about this repo's own `RecordDetailView.tsx` — so this array mirrored no protocol schema and drifted freely: it declared `columns` as `TableColumn[]` while the renderer it fed also accepted bare field names, `{ field, label }` and legacy `{ name, label }` spellings. The axis that carried the ruling was measured **zero pull**: no application code authored the member, both internal producers of a `detail-view` node (`RecordDetailDrawer`, `renderers/record-details.tsx`) synthesize it without `related`, and the only in-tree authorings carrying real columns were two documents — both rewritten here.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `c80236ec8` (merge-base with origin/main): 14 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1738 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2342 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36552543970)

**Checklist**
- **Shape.** Draft → `main`. The body opens `Fixes #11056`, then `Clause-②: no` at line start. Assignee `os-steve`, set by the dev's one `label-write` and read back.
- **Scope.** 15 files, +395 / −2, all inside the claim's surface:
  - the two handlers (`useConsoleActionRuntime`, `RecordDetailView`), one line each, now `t('actions.undone')`;
  - one key `actions.undone` in all ten packs;
  - two new pin files and a changeset.

  Each handler's `t` is the `useObjectTranslation()` it already declared ahead of `useGlobalUndo`. `useGlobalUndo` reads its options through a ref, so the confirmation follows a language switch after mount.
- **Governed-surface predicate.** 15 paths: `NOT governed`.
- **Checks on head `ae69f6e21`.** 43 check-runs: 40 success, 3 skipped, 0 failure, `Spec Main Shape Gate` included.
- **Commits.** Four, each with the model-free trailer pair.
- **Pins.** A zh pin and an en control per handler, under a real `I18nProvider`. The zh pins press the 撤销 button and assert 已撤销更改. The base blobs red both zh pins, and each handler's own pin alone, with the en controls green. Restore proven by blob.
- **Serial.** PR objectui#11074 (seat 2, objectui#11001) also edits `RecordDetailView.tsx`, in other hunks. A test merge of the two heads is clean.

**Wording and prose, verified by the seat** (no review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed: `Clause-②: no`, dispatched under the maintainer's 「当前没有fable，你可以派 opus 卡」):
- zh 已撤销更改 reads naturally and uses the pack's own 撤销 / 已撤销 and 更改 (the pack has 保存更改).
- en is unchanged, `Change undone`, so English output does not move.
- The changeset's claim about the other packs is true, pack by pack: each is its own `navigationSync.undone` without the word for navigation (de `Navigationsänderung rückgängig gemacht` → `Änderung rückgängig gemacht`, and likewise es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, ar).
- The changeset matches the diff; its closing line says `AppContent`'s Ctrl+Z handler is not changed, which is true.

**Filed in this act, from the dev's findings** (⛔ not graded here):
- objectui#11080: `AppContent`'s Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z toasts read `Undo: ` / `Redo: ` in English, and an unlabelled action's description is English too.
- objectui#11081: `useGlobalUndo` adds one `window` keydown listener per mounted instance, so one Ctrl+Z can undo several operations. It also fires inside a focused text field and prevents that field's own undo. Measured with a probe of the real hook; reach read from source.
- objectui#11082: `RecordDetailView`'s own `api` handler still captures its Undo snapshot as `?? null`, the shape objectui#10404 removed elsewhere. Read from source only.

**Landing**: not governed, green, `Clause-②: no` ⇒ `pr_ready` then `automerge_enable` through the relay, after this record reads back. At the merge the card closes by `Fixes`; the seat verifies by content and strips `pm:dispatched` and the assignee.
